about.label: 01 // about
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a software engineer with five years of hands-on experience in backend development, SaaS platform monitoring, and site reliability engineering — primarily within the retail and e-commerce space.
about.p2: At Onestock I grew from intern to SRE, working across an Order Management System used by major European retailers. I built and maintained RESTful APIs, refactored legacy code, automated validation tooling, and developed monitoring solutions that kept production reliable for thousands of concurrent users.
about.p3: I thrive in agile, collaborative environments and enjoy the intersection of engineering rigour and practical problem-solving. I'm now based in Adelaide on a Working Holiday Visa (subclass 417) and actively looking for my next challenge in South Australia.

items.name: OpSync — Shopify · 3PL · Xero Reconciliation Bot
items.summary: Automated financial reconciliation engine that cross-references three business platforms, flags discrepancies, and emails a daily report — built end-to-end in Python with Docker and n8n.
bullets: Designed a 5-check reconciliation engine across Shopify, Shippit (3PL), and Xero — detecting shipped-but-not-invoiced orders, quantity mismatches, price variances, and refund gaps with zero manual intervention.
Solved a real Shippit API limitation (no list-orders endpoint) by deriving fulfilment data from Shopify write-backs instead, keeping the integration clean and credential-free.
Built a paginated Shopify Admin REST client, Xero OAuth2 client, and Jinja2 HTML report renderer — each independently toggleable between live and mock mode for isolated testing.
Orchestrated the pipeline with n8n: daily 7 AM cron → POST /reconcile → conditional email alert if discrepancies found, via Mailpit in dev.
Containerised the full stack (FastAPI + n8n + Mailpit) with Docker Compose; mock dataset of 20 orders carries 6 deliberate discrepancies totalling $557.94 AUD to validate detection accuracy.
